issuing_body: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: Minn. Stat. § 609.5312 — Forfeiture of Property Associated with Designated Offenses
supports: Personal property used or intended to commit or facilitate a designated offense is subject to forfeiture, subject to statutory limitations.
Money and other real or personal property representing proceeds of a designated offense are subject to forfeiture, subject to statutory limitations.
selected_locators: Subd. 1(a) — property and proceeds subject to forfeiture
Subd. 2 — limitations on forfeiture and ownership/security-interest protections
important_qualifications: This section defines property subject to forfeiture; § 609.531 and related provisions govern who is an 'appropriate agency' and the procedure.
Forfeiture is legally distinct from enforcing a restitution judgment against a debtor's nonexempt assets.
